name: AuditWorkpaperSignoffTracker
tagline: Preparer, reviewer and partner sign-offs with open review notes – one control for the whole engagement file.
description: A complete audit engagement file sign-off app for Power Apps and Power Pages: workpaper index by section, three-level sign-off with role rights and segregation of duties, partner sign-off for significant risks, review notes that must be answered and cleared before sign-off, sign-off board, team workload and the file assembly deadline countdown.
features: Preparer / reviewer / partner sign-offs with names and dates
No sign-off with open review notes
Review notes: respond, clear, reject, reopen
Bulk sign-off, assign reviewer, due dates
controlType: standard (2 controls: AuditWorkpaperSignoffTracker data-set, AuditWorkpaperSignoffTrackerPortal field)
